description: The boundary case: every group deleted at once. The grid falls back to its Add Group empty state and the footer reads 0 groups — but all eleven tabs are still open and still listed, now under Ungrouped. Deleting groups removes groups, never tabs. Distinct from Home - Empty, which is a profile with no tabs either; this is the populated browser a user is left with the moment after clearing their last group. It is also the state the worker's deletion diff has to survive: removing the final label drops the `labels` key wholesale rather than writing an empty map, so `newValue` arrives undefined and deletedLabelTitles has to coerce it or the deletion goes unreported.
